soundness_flags.label: def:model-class; def:intrinsic-oracle; thm:oracle-adaptation-frontier and all downstream risk statements
soundness_flags.one_line: Because W is allowed to vary in P_{M,σ,L_N,L_T,W} but does not affect the law of Y, the same probability law can carry distinct W, F_P, s_P, and ψ_W; thus these are not functions of the declared element P of the law-class.

soundness_flags.label: C; Cq; all covariance-dependent definitions
soundness_flags.one_line: O is declared as a restriction map R^{N×T}→R^{|Ω|}, so O(Σ_T⊗Σ_N)O^⊤ is ill-typed; introduce an explicit vec-selection matrix S_Ω and use S_Ω(Σ_T⊗Σ_N)S_Ω^⊤.

soundness_flags.label: thm:ferrers-innovation-equivalence
soundness_flags.one_line: “Ferrers up to row and column permutations” is insufficient for lower-triangular transforms in the displayed fixed ordering: for Ω={(2,2)}⊂[2]^2, a permutation makes Ω northwest-closed, but O(Q_NX) at (2,2) depends on unobserved X_{1,2} when (Q_N)_{21}≠0.

soundness_flags.label: ass:oracle-regularity
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Xia–Yuan condition is an alignment condition for their random-sampling independent-noise variance, not comparability of a deterministic-mask covariance-minimum representer variance s² to σ²‖W‖_F²; retag this as novel and justify/derive it, or cite a result proving it in this design.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies uniformly random entry sampling with independent centered sub-Gaussian measurement noise and normalizes its linear-form estimator by σ_ξ(‖UᵀT‖_F²+‖TV‖_F²)^{1/2}; its stated nonregularity restriction is singular-space alignment of T.

The paper studies inference for approximate low-rank completion, allows dependent observation patterns and heterogeneous observation probabilities, and emphasizes a full-observed-sample procedure without sample splitting.

The published article treats an approximate spiked low-rank matrix whose rank grows slowly and whose nonzero singular values diverge, proving asymptotic normality and semiparametric efficiency for its rotated-regression procedure.

The article considers low-rank-plus-sparse recovery with arbitrary joint entrywise noise dependence and proves deterministic lower-bound tightness and matching minimax risks for structured matrix recovery.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make W a fixed deterministic target sequence W_n external to the law class, or replace P by a labelled parameter θ=(M,σ,L_N,L_T,W) and write P_θ throughout; then restate every modulus over θ rather than over an ambiguous set of laws.

Replace “Ferrers up to row and column permutations” by northwest closure in the ordering defining Q_N,Q_T, or explicitly conjugate both innovation factors under the permitted permutations; add the 2×2 nonordered sanity check.

Retag oracle regularity as a novel design-target condition and prove it from stated slab/Gram geometry for named target families, or weaken the coverage claim to targets for which an explicit lower variance bound is established.

Give one fully typed finite Ferrers instance using the new selection matrix that computes Δ_P, k, and the proposed score, thereby making the frontier operational rather than solely coordinate-defined.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision on this angle: repair the experiment parameterization and covariance typing first, then correct the fixed-order Ferrers characterization before Stage 0.
